items.title: Strive adds 2,000 bitcoin in biggest buy since June, closes in on MARA
items.summary: Strive’s bitcoin holdings near 30,000 BTC as the race among the largest public treasuries heats up.

items.title: ‘More orange than ever’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys 334 bitcoin for $28.7 million as total holdings top 848,000 BTC
items.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $73 billion.

items.title: Metaplanet added 1,000 bitcoin net in the third quarter bringing holdings to 44,000 BTC
items.summary: The Japanese firm sold 10,000 BTC before buying 11,000 BTC, demonstrating liquidity as it seeks recurring income from preferred securities.

items.title: Injective CEO Eric Chen expects US INJ ETFs to launch sooner than 2027
items.summary: There are currently two ETF applications tied to INJ — the 21Shares Injective ETF and the Canary Staked INJ ETF.
